db:select.doc:name: Select flights
db:select.db:sql: SELECT * FROM flights WHERE (:destination IS NULL OR toAirport = :destination)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (flight) -> { ID: flight.ID, code: (flight.code1 default "") ++ (flight.code2 default ""), price: flight.price default 0, departureDate: flight.takeOffDate as String default "", origin: flight.fromAirport default "", destination: flight.toAirport default "", emptySeats: flight.seatsAvailable default 0, plane: { "type": flight.planeType default "", totalSeats: flight.totalSeats default 0 } }
